entities.summary: Curtis Dean Brown is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. He was drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in the second round of the 1994 NHL Entry Draft. Over his National Hockey League (NHL) career, he played for the Sabres, San Jose Sharks, and Chicago Blackhawks.
